title: Is the Ocean Deeper Than Everest Is Tall?
description:
Put Everest at the deepest ocean point—would its summit reach the surface?

No. Challenger Deep is about 11 km deep, while Everest is about 8.85 km above sea level.

Even with Everest on the trench floor, more than 2 km of water would remain above the summit.

The vertical difference is larger than many commercial aircraft fly above the ground.
